answer: Unpredictable juried audits can resist sybils. Each epoch a public lottery seats a small jury and samples recently activated keys. A sampled agent must promptly return a unique custody proof plus a live work signal that is cheap to verify but costly to mint for many keys. If the proof is reused, late, or the history is hollow—only circulating among sibling keys—the jury slashes the bond and pays a bounty. Because the draw is secret in advance, every fake must stay fully bonded and able to answer; even an ember of idle clones can be seized, so capital and upkeep rise with the farm.
